core_obligations: Choose a K-injective complex I^bullet representing M, a K-injective complex J^bullet representing L, and an arbitrary complex K^bullet representing K (proof lines 18768-18770).

Use the composition statement for complexes to obtain the map from Tot(Hom^bullet(J^bullet, I^bullet) tensor_R Hom^bullet(K^bullet, J^bullet)) to Hom^bullet(K^bullet, I^bullet) (proof lines 18771-18778).
Record that the three Hom complexes represent R Hom_R(L, M), R Hom_R(K, L) and R Hom_R(K, M) respectively (proof lines 18779-18781).

Choose a K-flat complex H^bullet with a quasi-isomorphism H^bullet -> Hom^bullet(K^bullet, J^bullet), and obtain the displayed map from Tot(Hom^bullet(J^bullet, I^bullet) tensor_R H^bullet) to the previous total complex, whose source represents R Hom_R(L, M) tensor^L_R R Hom_R(K, L) (proof lines 18782-18793).
Compose the two displayed arrows to obtain the desired morphism; the author states that the proof of functoriality is omitted (proof lines 18794-18795).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a ring R and objects K, L, M of D(R) and asserts the existence of a canonical morphism R Hom_R(L, M) tensor^L_R R Hom_R(K, L) -> R Hom_R(K, M) in D(R), functorial in all three variables (source lines 18758-18765). The proof constructs the map at the level of complexes. It chooses a K-injective complex I^bullet representing M, a K-injective complex J^bullet representing L, and an arbitrary complex K^bullet representing K (proof lines 18768-18770). The composition statement for complexes then supplies a map of complexes from Tot(Hom^bullet(J^bullet, I^bullet) tensor_R Hom^bullet(K^bullet, J^bullet)) to Hom^bullet(K^bullet, I^bullet) (proof lines 18771-18778). The proof records that these three Hom complexes represent R Hom_R(L, M), R Hom_R(K, L) and R Hom_R(K, M) respectively (proof lines 18779-18781). The substantive step adapts the source to the derived tensor product: choosing a K-flat complex H^bullet with a quasi-isomorphism H^bullet -> Hom^bullet(K^bullet, J^bullet), the proof obtains the displayed map from Tot(Hom^bullet(J^bullet, I^bullet) tensor_R H^bullet) to the previous total complex, whose source represents R Hom_R(L, M) tensor^L_R R Hom_R(K, L) (proof lines 18782-18793). Composing the two displayed arrows gives the desired morphism, and the author states that the proof of functoriality is omitted (proof lines 18794-18795). The non-routine content is the insertion of the K-flat replacement so that the source actually computes the derived tensor product.
